_doc: Opportunity score = sum of signal points present on the lead. Tier needs BOTH the score and a written, specific problem. Edit points here, not in code.

no_website.label: No website, or Facebook/Instagram is the only web presence

site_not_mobile.label: Website has no mobile viewport or is hard to use on a phone

site_no_https.label: Website does not load over HTTPS

no_online_booking.label: Appointment business with no way to book or request online

slow_response.label: Reviews or posts mention missed calls, slow replies, or hard to reach

manual_orders.label: Takes orders or quotes by DM, text, or paper

outdated_site.label: Site shows old copyright, dead links, closed hours, or stale info

security_red_flag.label: Public sign of an account problem: hacked page, spoofed email, shared login

growing.label: Hiring, new location, or recently opened

decision_maker_known.label: Owner or decision maker identified by name and channel

served_industry.label: Industry Gray Matter already has a page and starter kit for

morning.purpose: First touch to qualified A/B leads not yet contacted

afternoon.purpose: Follow-ups that are due, replies to answer, calls to place

priority_segments._doc: Extra points by industry, set by ops/GTM.md section 2. Beachhead first.

weekly_targets._doc: Starting assumptions from ops/GTM.md section 6; replace with real numbers after 4 weeks.
